verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.steel.dev that returns HTTP 200 and describes Steel for AI agents. The docs also publish a machine-readable openapi.json and agent-directed setup, where the agent installs the Steel CLI plus the steel-browser skill to control a browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an llms-full.txt or per-page markdown variants, and verification of how complete the llms.txt index is.
